import {NextResponse} from "next/server"; import {db} from "@/lib/db"; import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
export async function POST(req:Request){try{const {phone,password}=await req.json();const user=await db.user.findUnique({where:{phone}});if(!user||!(await bcrypt.compare(password,user.password)))return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:"Invalid credentials"},{status:401});return NextResponse.json({success:true,user:{id:user.id,phone:user.phone,name:user.name,playerId:user.playerId}});}catch(e:any){return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:e.message},{status:500})}}

import {NextResponse} from "next/server"; import {Prisma} from "@prisma/client"; import {db} from "@/lib/db"; import {createNotification} from "@/action/notifications";
export async function POST(req:Request){try{const {invoice_no,status,amount}=await req.json();const record=await db.durantoPayDeposit.findUnique({where:{invoice_no}});if(!record)return NextResponse.json({message:"Deposit record not found"},{status:404});if(status!=="success"){await db.durantoPayDeposit.update({where:{invoice_no},data:{status:"FAILED"}});return NextResponse.json({message:"Transaction failed"});}await db.$transaction(async tx=>{const current=await tx.durantoPayDeposit.findUnique({where:{invoice_no}});if(current?.status==="COMPLETED")return;await tx.durantoPayDeposit.update({where:{invoice_no},data:{status:"COMPLETED"}});await tx.wallet.update({where:{userId:record.userId},data:{balance:{increment:new Prisma.Decimal(String(amount??record.amount))}}});});await createNotification({title:"Deposit Successful",description:`Your deposit of ${amount} BDT has been added.`,userId:record.userId,icon:"MONEY"});return NextResponse.json({message:"Deposit successful"});}catch(e:any){return NextResponse.json({error:e.message},{status:500})}}

import {NextRequest,NextResponse} from "next/server"; import {auth} from "@/auth"; import {db} from "@/lib/db";
export async function GET(req:NextRequest){try{const s=await auth();if(!s?.user?.id)return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:"Unauthorized"},{status:401});const q=req.nextUrl.searchParams;const limit=Math.min(Number(q.get("limit")||50),200);const rows=await db.gscWalletTransaction.findMany({where:{userId:s.user.id},orderBy:{createdAt:"desc"},take:limit});return NextResponse.json({success:true,transactions:rows});}catch(e:any){return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:e.message},{status:500})}}

import {NextResponse} from "next/server"; import {auth} from "@/auth"; import {db} from "@/lib/db";
export async function GET(){try{const s=await auth();if(!s?.user?.id)return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:"Not authenticated"},{status:401});const user=await db.user.findUnique({where:{id:s.user.id},select:{id:true,name:true,email:true,phone:true,playerId:true}});if(!user)return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:"User not found"},{status:404});return NextResponse.json({success:true,user});}catch(e){return NextResponse.json({success:false,error:"Internal server error"},{status:500})}}

source: export const launchGameFromAnyAPI = async (gameId:string, _playerId?:string, openGameMutation?:any) => { if(!gameId?.trim()) throw new Error("Game ID is required"); if(openGameMutation) return openGameMutation({gameId}).unwrap(); const r=await fetch("/api/open-game",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({gameCode:gameId})}); const d=await r.json(); if(!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error||"Game launch failed"); return d; };

An empty interface declaration allows any non-nullish value, including literals like `0` and `""`.
- If that's what you want, disable this lint rule with an inline comment or configure the 'allowInterfaces' rule option.
- If you want a type meaning "any object", you probably want `object` instead.
- If you want a type meaning "any value", you probably want `unknown` instead.
